items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Yes, I knew Jelly Roll. I used to listen at him standing on the corner of 132nd and Seventh Avenue and he told a lot of stories.

ctx.x: I wonder -- Butter and I were just talking about these trombones and things. I just want to digress a little bit. We're up through Cab's band, but I'd like to digress and just talk about some personalities of our era, some of the guys that you might have run into, and I just want to find out your impressions in which you knew about them.
Did you know Jelly Roll Morton at all?
